title: Glazin 8x: Aether Lost Content Edition
description: Glazin 8x Mod Support for The Aether: Lost Content.
body:
Glazin 8x: Aether Lost Content
September 1st, 2025

  The Glazin 8x Style has been introduced to The Aether Lost Content Mod. This Mod Support includes some of the most updated textures and palletes that can be found in Glazin 8x to date.
